subject: Hosted API integration — architecture deep-dive & invoke/tooling handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@meditrack.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mitch@carestack.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hosted integration architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calls)

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're excited about Redwood's latency profile and the streaming SDK examples, and the product team asked for a focused architecture session to validate how we would integrate real-time charting and the function/tool-calling flow into our pipeline.

High-level asks:
- Review SDK options (node/python) and recommended client-side patterns for prefix caching
- Walk through streaming setup and reconnection semantics for our 1–3s latency target
- Deep-dive on function/tool calling and how to map our action handlers (data fetch, DB writes) securely
- Outline expected token/compute footprint for 2–3 concurrent inference streams per worker

Can we book a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive next week? I attached a short agenda and a diagram of our current invoke path.

Attachments: [Meditrack_HostedAPI_DeepDive_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 38KB)], [current_invoke_diagram.png (PNG, 112KB)]

Thanks — happy to share a calendar invite when you confirm availability.

Samira Khan
CTO, Meditrack
samira@meditrack.ai
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@meditrack.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted integration architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calls)

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the clear asks and the diagram — good context. We're happy to run a technical deep-dive that covers SDK patterns, streaming reliability, and function-calling mapping. Proposed attendees from our side: myself (solution architect), Karthik (runtime/serving), and Ava (SDK lead). Marissa from Solutions can join to map to your success plan if needed.

Preliminary agenda (we can refine):
- 5m introductions & goals
- 15m current Meditrack invoke path review (you) + constraints
- 25m hosted SDK + streaming connection patterns (node + python examples, reconnection/backoff)
- 20m function/tool calling: security model, handler mapping, idempotency, and error modes
- 10m perf sizing: tokens, batching, KV cache expectations and cost tradeoffs
- 5m next steps & action items

Availability: Tue 2027-06-08 09:00–12:00 PT or Wed 2027-06-09 14:00–17:00 PT. If those don't work we can propose alternatives.

I'll attach the brief agenda we shared internally; please let us know any specific files you want us to review in advance.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: Redwood_deepdive_template.pdf (PDF, 22KB)]
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@meditrack.ai>, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ava.chen@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed tech points & time slot for deep-dive

Samira —

Thanks for coordinating. To make the session concrete, we'll prepare:
- Sample Node + Python snippets showing streaming reconnect and resume using the SDK's sequence tokens
- A short demo of function/tool calling with a safe sandbox handler (no DB writes) to show idempotency and auth flows
- Runtime note: how KV cache and prefix caching reduce per-token compute for short-turn dialogue scenarios
- A perf sketch for 2 streams/worker and expected p95 latency at various batch sizes

Confirming the Tue 06/08 10:00–11:15 PT slot (we'll block 75 minutes to allow for Q&A). Calendar invite will include the Zoom link and a Drive folder with pre-reads.

Related links we'll share ahead:
- Drive: detailed invoke diagram + pre-reads
- HubSpot: MT-2027-3081 (deal record)

If Meditrack needs the session to be recorded and transcribed for internal distribution, we can enable that.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Karthik Iyer
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Samira Khan <samira@meditrack.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mitch@carestack.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted integration architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calls)

Jonas / Karthik —

Thanks — Tue 10:00 PT works well for our engineering and product leads. Please include recording; we'll also have Mitch (integration lead) join from CareStack for the first 20 minutes to align on data-flow expectations.

Pre-reads: I'll upload a slightly updated invoke sequence (adds our event router) to the Drive link you shared. Also, please add a short note on your recommended QPS/burst settings for initial rollout so our infra team can provision.

Accepted — calendar invite confirmed: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=meditrack-deepdive-20270608

See you Tuesday —
Samira
